integration_issues.issue: Global axios 401 interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (L137-148) redirects to /login on ANY 401, even for unauthenticated visits to /, /subscriptions when public components fire authenticated probes (e.g. /me/* preflight, status pill subscribe). This makes the public site UN-reachable when the visitor has no token. Likely a pre-existing behavior worsened by the iter26 SupportLoadGauge inline call which may probe an authenticated endpoint. Recommendation: extend NO_LOGOUT_ON_401 to include `/me/support/*` (gauge feed) and any public-facing endpoint, OR have public components not call /me/* without a token. This blocked live UI verification of BUG1+FEATURE2 (single-navbar / sticky+inline gauge).

action_items: (P1) Investigate which public-page network call returns 401 and triggers the global redirect; fix by either (a) marking that endpoint truly public on the backend, (b) gating the call client-side to authenticated users, or (c) extending NO_LOGOUT_ON_401 in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js to whitelist that path. This is needed so public marketing pages (/, /subscriptions) actually render without a session token — currently any clean visit redirects to /login.

(P3) Once the public-page 401 is unblocked, re-run a focused Playwright pass to assert: (i) marketing-navbar count==1 on /subscriptions; (ii) support-load-gauge-inline count==1 inside the navbar; (iii) support-load-gauge (banner) count==0; (iv) navbar bounding box top stays ~0 after window.scrollTo(0,800).

(P3) For BUG3, automated test should: login as admin via portal, go to /admin/settings, scroll the main column via main.scrollTop=1000 (NOT window.scrollTo), then assert sidebar bounding box top=0 and height==window.innerHeight (>=900px).

rca of the issue: Live frontend testing of BUG1 (double-header on /subscriptions) and FEATURE2 (sticky navbar with inline gauge) was not possible because Playwright sessions visiting `/` or `/subscriptions` get redirected to `/login` by the axios response-interceptor in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js (lines 137-148): on ANY 401 that is not an auth or telemetry endpoint, the interceptor calls `window.location.href = '/login'`. Some component on the marketing pages is calling an authenticated /me/* endpoint without a token (likely status/incident or the new SupportLoadGauge probe), causing 401 → forced /login. Mitigation options for the main agent: (a) extend NO_LOGOUT_ON_401 in api.js to whitelist the offending path, OR (b) refactor the offending public component to skip the call when no token is present, OR (c) make the backend endpoint truly public (no auth). Code review confirms BUG1, FEATURE2, BUG3, FEATURE4-FE source changes are in place and correct — only live e2e verification of the public-page UI parts is pending.
